name: vlm_change_detection
description: Bi-temporal change detection using real pretrained vision-transformer embeddings (CLIP, via transformers), instead of raw pixel differencing. Compares corresponding patch embeddings between two acquisitions via cosine distance — a genuine semantic-dissimilarity signal, not a trained bi-temporal change model. NOT fine-tuned on remote sensing or on change detection itself, so absolute distances are uncalibrated. Requires the optional 'vlm' extra (torch + transformers); refuses via analysis_unavailable if unavailable.

modality.description: Modality of the input pair (used only for labeling the summary)

change_map_path.description: Path to the patch-level change map

change_summary.description: Natural language summary of detected semantic change

changed_area_pct.description: Percentage of patches flagged as semantically changed

change_embedding.description: Flattened grid of per-patch cosine distances between the two acquisitions' ViT embeddings
